notes: output_00017 is the raw-conservative cuRAMSES HDF5 checkpoint built with Horizon5-master-2. uold_1 is density, uold_2..uold_4 are momentum densities, uold_5 is total-energy density, uold_6 is the metal mass density (imetal=6), and uold_7 is the delayed-cooling reservoir (idelay=7). The H/O/Fe-like element slots uold_8..uold_10 are retained for a later element audit. Dust and non-equilibrium ionization remain explicit pilot placeholders, so this map is ineligible for production-contract mode.
